Card Q&A.a: No, this card's inherited effect does not allow ignoring digivolution requirements, so you can only digivolve into a card that meets the digivolution requirements.
Card Q&A.q: When I use this card's inherited effect to digivolve into [Eosmon] in my hand, can it digivolve regardless of its digivolution requirements?

Effect: [Your Turn] When this Digimon would digivolve into [Eosmon], reduce the digivolution cost by 1.
Inherited Effect: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When another [Eosmon] is played, this Digimon may digivolve into [Eosmon] in your hand with the digivolution cost reduced by 3.
